thread:
Aisha: quick ask for eng/runtime — marketing needs validated bench numbers for the launch post + webinar. primary metrics: p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/s, end-to-end wall time, and GPU memory. seq lengths: 512, 2048, 8192. request cold vs warmed cache. deadline: 72h. keep runs reproducible and minimal.

Ben: add: note kernel id, batch-size distribution, and any kernel fallbacks. p95/p99 will be quoted in the blog so accuracy matters.

Sam: ok — fp16 baseline + int8. do you want a 'real prompt' set and a synthetic stress set? also confirm reps per prompt.

Aisha: yes. i'll drop two files in marketing/bench_assets: `launch_real_12.txt` and `webinar_synthetic_150.jsonl`. reps: 200 for synthetic, 50 for real. mark all outputs internal until we greenlight.

Kai: plan: three cache states — cold (fresh process), warmed (same session reuse), prefix-cached (shared prefix). we'll capture per-step GPU utilization and kernel selection. we'll also fix RNG seed for synthetic runs.

Sam: CSV schema we'll produce: run_id, model, quant_mode, seq_len, cache_state, reps, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_s, gpu_mem_mb, avg_batch, kernel_id, anomalies, docker_image, git_commit. any additions?

Ben: include cost_est_usd_per_1m_tokens and a short human note field for weirdness.

Kai: example bench command (under /bench/runtime/marketing):
```
./bench_runner --model gpt-rlhf-1 --quant int8 --seq 2048 --prompts marketing/bench_assets/launch_real_12.txt --cache_state warmed --reps 50 --out /tmp/bench_176912
```

deploy-bot: scheduled bench job 1769130001 by Sam (eng-runtime) — status: queued :gear:

ops-bot: infra note: jobs with 8k seq may need a larger instance; @ops will monitor for throttles.

Sam: smoke run now (small sample) — will push CSV to shared drive and attach raw logs. full runs tomorrow (int8 + fp16) across sequences and cache states. we'll annotate any kernel fallbacks or transient OOMs in the anomalies column.

Aisha: can we get the smoke CSV within 24h? marketing needs p95 numbers for a draft slide.

Sam: yep — smoke CSV by tomorrow morning. full annotated CSVs + README with run commands, images, and caveats in 72h.

Ben: thanks — once we have p95/p99 we'll iterate wording so we don't overclaim. :thumbsup:

Aisha: perfect, appreciate the hustle. :rocket:
